statements.impact_statement: RUSTSEC-2025-0119 is an unmaintained-status advisory, not a vulnerability. `number_prefix` is a tiny formatting library used by `indicatif` for progress-bar prefixes (e.g. `1.2 kB`). Pulled in only via `springtale-cli`'s progress UI — never executed against attacker-controlled input. No known soundness or correctness issues; the crate is feature-complete for what it does.
statements.action_statement: Track `indicatif` upstream; will drop the transitive when `indicatif` switches formatters or `number_prefix` is taken over by a new maintainer. No production exposure.
